d: Here is some Rafaela/La Pluma in multiple positions. I saw people were asking why I made the characters happy, even if it was out of character for them. I just like seeing them happy, so sorry if it breaks the immersion for you. If you want me to try certain characters, let me know and I'll try to get them to work. I'm working on a set for Gavial The Invincible right now, but it will probably take a while.
